## Question the workflow answers

Which genes, transcripts, splicing events, and co-expression modules differ between genotypes, and which of those differences are consistent across contrasts that share a causal factor.

## Layers

| Layer | Tools | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Gene-level DE | DESeq2, limma-voom, edgeR (run in parallel; consensus reported) | Per-contrast tables with log2FC, shrunken log2FC, adjusted p |
| Transcript usage | IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR + satuRn; DEXSeq for exon usage | Isoform-fraction changes with switch consequences |
| Splicing | rMATS (five event types) | PSI differences per event, FDR |
| Co-expression | WGCNA | Modules, module–trait correlations, hub genes |
| Regulatory network | GENIE3, 10 random seeds, edge intersection across seeds | Consensus TF–target edges |

: {.project-meta}

## Design and covariates

- Reference: AaegL5.0 with the matching NCBI annotation release; contig names checked against the FASTA before alignment.
- Batch entered as a covariate in the DE model. Batch-corrected counts (ComBat-seq) were not used for inference because batch and group were partially confounded; the covariate approach is the conservative choice and is stated as such.
- Contrasts are defined in a single config file; every layer reads the same sample sheet and the same contrast list.

## QC before inference

FastQC/MultiQC, alignment rate, rRNA fraction, strandedness check, gene-body coverage, library complexity, and a PCA on variance-stabilised counts with batch and group labelled. Exclusion criteria are written in the config and applied by the pipeline, not by hand.

## Reproducibility

`renv` lockfile for R, pinned container for aligners, Snakemake driver, and output directories `01_inputs/ … 06_reports/` with a `logs/` tree. Figures and tables are script-generated.
